svg.title: DES-008 prototype stereo sandwich and local cooling envelope
svg.desc: Functional section, not an engineered assembly. Two sensors have opposite 20 milliradian rotations and 5 millimetre mid-plane separation. The free face gap is 4.7 millimetres. Trial interfaces, skins and a 3.2 millimetre tube leave 0.7 millimetres in the normal direction. Mounting and service routes are unresolved.
